system.description:
• Effect: Song, oration, battle cry or demeanour.
  • Uses per day equal to your Charisma modifier + half your Bard level, rounded up (minimum 2).
  • Spend a use as part of your action, once per round, so you can still cast or attack.
  • Saves against your Performance use your spell save DC.
  • You are Trained in Singing or one Musical Instrument of your choice, on top of your starting skills; a Performance check, wherever the books name one, is a Charisma check with one of these.
  • Your Performance options:
  • Exalt (the default): one ally within 60ft who can see and hear you has Advantage on attribute checks and saves, including checks for class features but not attack rolls, for the encounter.
  • Only one Exalt is in effect at a time: a new one ends the last.
  • Exalt reaches 2 allies at 6th level, 3 at 12th and 4 at 18th.
  • Discord: a sharp jeer or discordant note, costing no use. A target within 30ft makes a Will save or its next hit before the end of its next turn deals half damage.

activities.name: Exalt
activities.text: The default Performance, as part of your action: {1:one ally, 6:2 allies, 12:3 allies, 18:4 allies} within 60ft who can see and hear you have Advantage on attribute checks and saves (including class ability checks, not attack rolls) for the encounter.

activities.name: Discord
activities.text: A sharp jeer or discordant note, costing no use: a target within 30ft makes a Will save (your spell DC) or its next hit before the end of its next turn deals half damage.

activities.name: Rally
activities.text: Allies within earshot roll again against any fear effect on them, and allied NPCs who failed a Morale Check roll it again; those who succeed ignore that fear source for the rest of the encounter.

activities.name: Exhort Greatness
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. {1:One creature, 11:2 creatures, 15:3 creatures, 19:4 creatures} (you may choose yourself) who can hear you and stay within 30ft may reroll one attack roll or save each round for the encounter, keeping the new roll, and gain temporary HP equal to twice their Level once per encounter (inspiring again renews only the reroll).

activities.name: Words of Power
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. One creature makes a Will save (your spell DC) or is Shaken and Slowed until the end of its next turn. {1:, 17:A creature of Level no more than half yours that fails is also Stunned for 1 round.}

activities.name: Sway Crowd
activities.text: Costs 2 uses, out of combat: Fascinate everyone who can hear you, whatever language they speak, up to {1:20, 16:40, 19:80, 20:160} Levels of creatures, lowest Level first. A creature that is attacked or sees an ally attacked saves again at once. {1:, 20:You may give the Fascinated crowd one Mass Suggestion that lasts a week (Will save to resist).}

rules.value: Discord: its next hit before the end of its next turn deals half damage.
Exhorted: once each round, reroll one attack roll or save.
